title: Audit: independent recount confirms #696's 22–25% primitive saving (no new kappa)
head: e3576811d416f91dc80b995ce4b8bc8a6144509e
body:
Independent audit of #696 by Sagar Thakrar (`thakrarsagar`) at head `5a3f983715027c4fd83f50bc9001d4b18463bed1`. **Verdict: the 22–25% primitive claim is confirmed exactly. It does not change κ.**

Exact base: `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60` (current `main`, also the base of #696). Only `research/community-pr696-audit/` is added. Credit for the construction belongs to #696.

### Reproduce

```sh
python3 -B research/community-pr696-audit/recount.py
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_PR696_INDEPENDENT_RECOUNT savings=55320,55352,56852,56884 percent=22.10-24.60 kappa_inputs_unchanged=True
```

The recount uses the standard library, runs offline, writes nothing and takes about 3 minutes. It imports no #696 code.

### Findings

| Program | Old | New | Saved | % |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| CK forward | 224,938 | 169,618 | 55,320 | 24.59 |
| CK backward | 224,986 | 169,634 | 55,352 | 24.60 |
| JP8 forward | 257,232 | 200,380 | 56,852 | 22.10 |
| JP8 backward | 257,280 | 200,396 | 56,884 | 22.11 |

- The re-derived Horner baseline equals each emitter's `real_component_primitive_bound`. The re-implemented copy-init and unit rules match every #696 count. The saving equals `2·(additions + units)` in every program.
- A separate randomized replay checks every complete program twice per real component, with dirty private work. After every macro the old and new states are equal, and `W = 0` after each addition. Every value the new word writes to a register also occurs in that register in the old trace.
- **κ:** the selected assembly (`complex-k492-owner-repair/code/assemble.py`) computes κ from the paid profile, `m = 73`, `live`, the deficit and the PR543 bit profile. Scalar primitives enter only the finite per-vertex invoice and its pass/fail inequalities, which already pass. Over the 72 selected calls, the lowering saves 4,082,112 of 18,263,888 scalar primitives, or 8.7·10⁻¹⁰ of the per-vertex allowance. This cannot feed a κ gain in the current model.

### Limits

`make verify`, the cold selected replay and Lean were not run. The inherited geometric, compiler, hosting, precision and tape contracts were not audited. Open #681, which consolidates #696, was not audited.

Rohan Guliani (@Rohansguliani), with substantial AI assistance. New files are under the repository's Apache-2.0 license.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
